description: Source code for ewah_io.c, handling serialization and deserialization of ewah_bitmaps, including functions for writing to buffers, memory mapping, and related utilities.

methods.name: ewah_serialize_to
methods.description: Serializes an ewah_bitmap to a buffer using a provided write function, including bitmap size, compressed data, and RLW position.

methods.name: ewah_serialize_strbuf
methods.description: Serializes an ewah_bitmap into a strbuf object.

methods.name: ewah_read_mmap
methods.description: Reads and maps an ewah_bitmap from a memory-mapped region, handling endianness and data integrity checks.
